contract: A commit with a stale generation stores nothing.
One request can store a valid partition and reject an invalid partition without rolling back the valid one.
Deleting one group leaves another group's offset in place.
Reopen restores the remaining offset, generation, and offset count.
limits: This is not the OffsetCommit, OffsetFetch, or DeleteGroups RPC.
Transactional offset commits stay on KL11-26, which can now see this store.
The journal format is the local PLGOFF01 snapshot.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
